description.value: Homer St Cafe & Bar is a Michelin-recommended contemporary neighbourhood restaurant occupying the historic Homer Building and the newer Beasley Building in Vancouver's Yaletown District. The kitchen centres on a fire engine red rotisserie that slow-roasts a rotating cast of proteins, anchoring a menu of classic comfort cooking. Brunch, lunch, dinner, and daily happy hour are all on offer, and walk-ins are always welcome.
